Name: Fixed Ginger Island Beach Garden Pots
Author: wilsoncwc
Description:
With the advent of [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Version_History#1.6.6]version 1.6.6[/url], savvy farmers have been eager to exploit the new mechanic that enables bee houses to work with flowers in garden pots.
Alas, attempts to establish a garden pot in the beach area were met with the disheartening error message, "Can't be planted here".

No more! With this mod, you can now cultivate your favorite crops and flowers (i.e. Fairy Rose) in garden pots right on the beach.
Complete your tropical bee house empire and enjoy the sweet rewards of your beachfront apiary.

[b][WARNING][/b]
This is a new mod that alters game code. The intent of the garden pot restriction is unclear, and as such overriding it may lead to unintended side effects.
Use at your own risk.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[*]Enjoy!
[/list]
[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6.6+ on any platform.
[*]Should not interfere with most mods, including other garden pot mods.
[*]There are no known multiplayer limitations.
[/list]
[size=5]See also[/size][url=https://github.com/wilsoncwc/StardewValleyMods][list]
[*]Source code
[/list][/url]
